text:
Linhua Zhou. Student at New York University (2026 – present).

Project: Campus Decoder (Aug 2026 – Sep 2026). Built and shipped an AI-powered tool that helps college students decode confusing campus situations, from office hours and emailing professors to group project conflicts. Developed as my first hackathon project for GatewayHacks 2026. Took the project from idea to a fully deployed product. Live at campusdecoder.com.

Skills: TypeScript, Cloudflare, AI, web design.
